Thanks — reviewed the attachments. Key holdback and risk notes:

- Retention add-on (pending SOW): not billable until signed; exposure = $120,000 ARR. Recommend we mark this as contingent and exclude from committed ARR until procurement signs.
- Usage drop in Insights module: two support tickets (IDs: BW-5471, BW-5502) escalate config-related ingestion lag; these are correlated with a 28% usage dip. Marissa, if you confirm product signals align, we should treat this module as "at-risk" and apply a conservative probability (50-60%).
- Procurement rate-card change: procurement sent a doc with revised discount tiers; if accepted it would lower effective ARR by ~6%. Procurement has requested Redwood to produce the revised SOW (doc: procurement_sow_v2.docx).

Recommendation: produce two forecast lines for BrightWave — "base committed" (exclude contingent SOW), and "optimistic pending procurement" (include SOW and adjusted usage recovery). For internal reporting keep a third column "churn-risk rationale" with ticket refs and timeline to resolution.

I'll drop inline comments in the Drive copy (linked) and can join a 20–30 min call with BrightWave and procurement to walk the SOW items.

-David
